Name: (Repeal) Junimo and Bird Animation Lamp
Author: tikamin557
Description:

[/color][/size][size=6]﻿﻿[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42341][size=6]Junimo and Bird Animation Lamp[/size][/url]﻿[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]
(If you install a newer version of the mod, be sure to delete this mod file.)[/b][/size][/color][/quote][color=#ffff00][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color][/center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color]


This furniture will not be sold in the store.
It is available from the Furniture Catalog.

If you have a large variety of items that crowd the catalog menu, you can hide them from the mod config settings.

In-game items are available in English and Japanese by default.
The mod config displays both English and Japanese descriptions.

The furniture that is the source of the texture changes in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version is the "Country Lamp".
[size=3][color=#ffff00]Added in version 1.2.[/color]
[/size]Textures can also be applied to the "Wood Lamp-post" for outdoor installations.


[color=#ffff00][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] Version Notes.[/size][/color]
1) Because the vanilla lamps and textures have been replaced, there is a discrepancy between the position of the light source and the position of the texture.
2) The animation does not work if the texture is changed after the lamp is placed on a table or other surface. This is also an AT specification and not a bug. If you want the animation to work on a table top, use the DGA version.
[s]3) There is a setting for textures that change with the seasons, but this is currently not working due to a glitch in the AT.[/s]
[color=#ffff00][size=3]Supported in version 1.2.[/size][/color]
3) Textures now change automatically with the seasons using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
Unlike the AT specifications, there is no need to re-set the textures for each season.


Note: The images in Media are a mixture of those using the color reduction mod and vanilla color.

Note: Junimo animations were created by referencing the number of frames in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3996]Animated Junimo Scarecrows[/url].
